name: villaggio
description: Gioco mobile: da foresta selvaggia a metropoli. HTML/CSS/JS + Capacitor (Android/iOS).

scripts.android: node build.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: node build.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:run: node build.mjs && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:run: node build.mjs && npx cap run ios
scripts.apk: node build.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
